column1: # Backlog probes: today's wrong behaviour of open items, one probe per finding.
# Run by tools/run_backlog.py (CTest aether_backlog); its docstring defines the columns.
# A probe that flips fails the lap: fix the ledger and guide lines in the same commit,
# then move the probe into tests/ as a regression fixture and delete its row.

column5: note
Int/Int `/` is Real outside a typed sink, so 7/2 == 3 is false
`0..7 / 2` runs 4 times: the bound is 3.5
names ignore case: `let limit` overwrote `const LIMIT` before W4-22
parameter `limit` answered to `LIMIT` before W4-22
a loop variable named like a let left the let at 0 before W4-22
record == compares identity
`ret` is not checked against the declared type
`let b: Bool = 5` is accepted
`ret 7` from -> Bool prints 7
`@cost("O(n)")` is silently dropped (ideas: Malformed `@cost` is silently dropped)
ret inside fx compiles and runs, but the full guide still forbids it
`a b` juxtaposition keeps a and drops b
`18 <= age < 65` was (18 <= age) < 65 before W4-15
`let s = trim(s)` reads the new, empty slot; NAME-001 (W4-22 interim) until W5-24 lands
a duplicate fn is silently last-wins
the range bound is re-read every pass
the backend's `result` local shadows the user's global
`s[i] = t` with a Text variable is an uncoded VM error
chr(233) prints through CP437
`ret 5` from -> Text prints 5
